paper_id: Improving Controllable Text Generation with Position-Aware Weighted Decoding
title: Improving Controllable Text Generation with Position-Aware Weighted Decoding
motivation: Weighted decoding方法在提高控制强度的同时导致文本质量下降,存在控制强度与流畅度的权衡困境
problem_framing: 将控制强度/流畅度权衡问题重新形式化为控制器在所有位置施加偏置而忽略LM原始输出分布的矛盾
key_insight: 通过检测LM输出分布与目标属性的差异,在不同解码位置自适应抑制或放大控制器偏置信号
method_signature: CAT-PAW框架在加权解码方法上添加位置感知调节器,动态调整控制信号强度
evaluation_criteria: slope(权衡曲线斜率)作为核心指标,同时评估控制强度/困惑度/区分度
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 可训练调节器因伪数据噪声反而不如启发式调节器;多义词关键词(如military)使启发式调节器产生混淆
evidence_for_taste: trade-off is due to the controller assigning bias signals to all decoding positions while ignoring the original results of LMs
an ideal controllable generator should generate high-quality text under different control strengths
degeneration often happens when a serious mismatch occurs between output distributions of the LM and the target attribute
the heuristic one (H) performs better than the trainable one (T). We hypothesize that it is due to the noises in the pseudo data
Heuristic regulator in our CAT-PAW is sometimes confused about the LM's preference when facing these keywords
thinking_moves: 从权衡曲线的几何特征(斜率)而非单点性能重新定义任务成功标准
将控制失败归因于时序位置错配而非方法本身缺陷
借鉴对比思维:当LM已倾向目标属性时应放大控制,否则应抑制
采用最简启发式方法作为训练数据不足时的保守基线
cites_own_work: Xiaocheng Feng is the corresponding author of this work
